findings.current: I drew heat from deep within myself and sent it through every limb and acupoint.
findings.defect: The Korean says the heat flows through the limbs and body (사지백해), not through acupoints. The translation substitutes a specific anatomical pathway that the source does not state.
findings.rationale: 사지백해 refers broadly to the limbs and body; acupoints are not mentioned in this sentence.
findings.replacement: I drew heat from deep within myself and sent it through my limbs and throughout my body.

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one minor physical-detail substitution in the description of heat moving through the body.
